articles.title: NASA Is Hiring Astronauts — Could You Be Next?
articles.summary: NASA is hiring new astronauts for Moon and Mars missions, but applicants need a STEM master's degree, three years of experience, and a passed physical — and applications close December 3, 2026.

articles.title: Turkey, Trots, and Touchdowns: How Thanksgiving Traditions Began
articles.summary: From roast turkey to morning races, a turkey pardon, and football, Thanksgiving is full of traditions with surprising histories — and this year it falls on November 26.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo Shares a Sadder Side of Christmas
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo releases the official version of her sad Christmas ballad 'Miss This Christmas' on Amazon Music, the flip side of her upbeat first Christmas song.
